title: 第398章 番外：权臣在现代（四）
slug: 读心后疯批暴君决定洗白
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

闲聊完了，就该干正事了。

原主所在的这家大型游戏公司旗下有多款手游，目前最热门的游戏就是去年年初开发的——逐鹿三界。

这是一款古风角色扮演冒险类手游，玩法颇多，人气最高的玩法莫过于玩家之间的PK，除了PK用的装备外，玩家携带的宠物以及身上穿的锦衣也都是吸引玩家充值的要素。

眼看着就要过年了，公司给策划组的任务是年前开放新门派，毕竟节假日是玩家流量最高的时候，尤其春节有长假，新门派和新锦衣如果能戳中玩家的心坎，引起较高的话题热度，玩家就会乐意买账。

在此前组内开会讨论过，新门派为远程输出，角色建模和技能的动作设计必须美观，才好引得玩家们充钱转职。

宋雲初思索良久后，将手伸向了键盘。

2025新门派初步设定如下——

门派：飘渺宗（法系）

门派师傅：月满仙人

经脉一：飘渺真诀（全攻击状态）

经脉二：清心养元（高防御状态）

门派技能：普攻、飞沙走石、一苇渡江、引鹤乘风、移形换影、天外飞仙、横贯六合……

傍晚时分，宋雲初回到家中。

这个世界的工作，似乎也没有那么累。

前世地位虽高，奈何与皇帝离心，既要对付朝中那些挡路人，又要提防皇帝对她下手，日子总过得草木皆兵。

她也是死后才知，皇帝没有她想象的那般狠毒，若不是她生了二心，皇帝大约也不会过河拆桥吧。

罢了，不想那些。

反正如今这个时代，不会总有人惦记着要取她性命了。

在接下来的几天里，宋雲初把自己心心念念的美食挨个品尝了一遍，各个牌子的奶茶也是每天一杯。

这天是周五，宋雲初回到家时，林夕正站在冰箱前，琢磨着晚上要煮什么。

宋雲初坐下拿出了手机，就看见祝卿安发来的信息——

我想吃火锅了！你住的小区对面那家牛肉火锅好吃吗？

宋雲初回：我也没吃过。

祝卿安：那要不去试个毒？把林夕叫上，我七点能到。

宋雲初觉得可行，转头朝林夕说道：“不用煮饭了，安安说吃火锅。”

七点十分，三人齐聚火锅店。

宋雲初前世吃不了辣，但如今这副躯体很能吃辣，于是她照着原主的记忆调了料汁，放了一把小米辣。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After the small talk, it’s time to get down to business.

The large game company where the original owner works has many mobile games under its umbrella. The most popular game at present is the game developed at the beginning of last year - Zhulu Three Realms.

This is an ancient role-playing adventure mobile game with many gameplays. The most popular gameplay is PK between players. In addition to the equipment used for PK, the pets carried by players and the brocade clothes they wear are also factors that attract players to recharge.

The New Year is about to come, and the company’s task for the planning team is to open new sects before the year. After all, the holidays are the time when player traffic is the highest, especially the long Spring Festival holiday. If the new sects and new brocade clothes can touch the hearts of players and arouse high topic popularity, players will be happy to buy it.

It was previously discussed in the group meeting that the new sect is a remote output, and the character modeling and skill action design must be beautiful to attract players to invest money and change careers.

After Song Yunchu thought for a long time, he reached out to the keyboard.

The preliminary settings of the new sect in 2025 are as follows——

Sect: Piaomiao Sect (Legal System)

Master of the sect: Moon Man Immortal

Meridian One: Piaomiao True Secret (Full Attack State)

Meridian 2: Clear the heart and nourish the energy (high defense state)

Skills of the sect: basic attack, flying sand and stones, crossing the river with a reed, attracting the crane to ride the wind, changing shape, flying immortals from the sky, traveling across the world...

In the evening, Song Yunchu returned home.

The work in this world doesn’t seem so tiring.

Although she had a high status in her previous life, she was separated from the emperor. She had to deal with those who stood in the way in the court, and she also had to be wary of the emperor attacking her. Her life was always full of enemies.

It was only after she died that she learned that the emperor was not as vicious as she imagined. If she hadn't had second thoughts, he probably wouldn't have burned the bridge.

That's all, don't think about that.

Anyway, in this day and age, there won't always be people thinking about taking her life.

In the next few days, Song Yunchu tasted all the delicacies he had longed for, and drank one cup of milk tea of ​​each brand every day.

It was Friday. When Song Yunchu returned home, Lin Xi was standing in front of the refrigerator, thinking about what to cook at night.

Song Yunchu sat down and took out his mobile phone, and saw the message from Zhu Qingan——

I want to eat hot pot!Is the beef hotpot restaurant across from your neighborhood delicious?

Song Yun’s first reply: I haven’t eaten it either.

Zhu Qingan: How about trying some poison?Call Lin Xi, I'll be there at seven o'clock.

Song Yunchu thought it was feasible, turned to Lin Xi and said, "No need to cook, An An said to eat hot pot."

At ten past seven, the three of them gathered at the hot pot restaurant.

Song Yunchu couldn't eat spicy food in her previous life, but now her body can tolerate spicy food very well, so she mixed the sauce according to the memory of the original owner and added a handful of spicy millet.
